read_defect.condition: curTopKIdx == validCount; GetValue currently occurs before the bound check, including invalid new work in pipeline drain. Physical allocation overflow depends on row/shape; not claimed to recur for the current 8K K2048 C1 record.

fix_invariants: Initial GetValue executes iff curTopKIdx < validCount. Out-of-range cursor uses the existing -1 termination path, setting actual size/alignment/tail to zero; all in-range sentinel and tail arithmetic remains unchanged.
The finite outer s2 loop advances independently of the top-k cursor. Bounds termination does not return from PreloadPipeline and does not change its valid flags or older tasks.

CalcParams:641 makes new work invalid for each of the final two drain iterations. PreloadPipeline:883-898 still completes older Vec1/Mm2 and Vec2 work: first drain finishes the last Mm2 and penultimate Vec2; second drain finishes the last Vec2.
No indexer backing guard is part of this fix. Existing token index shape and original element order remain unchanged.
C1_source_contract: Actual 9.2 API header:47-48 supports BF16 on arch2201; :234-243 permits nValue1 and NZ strides1; :305-310 requires 32B destination alignment, not a minimum row count4.

Cube:47-63,73-112,393-438: one-token copies have nValue1; BF16 destination row stride16 elements is32B. Current key/rope/value copy widths256/32/128 are32B multiples; selected rows write separate NZ rows.
Cube:528-558 maps block id*bsize and clips its causal end. For bsize1 every selected ID yields at most one token; cursor and page loops do not round to4.
Kernel:379-383,689-709 uses per-query threshold KV_length-Q_length+i+1 and original row offsets. C1 needs no block repack, shape change, or appended tail tokens.

Kernel:735-760 and vector:1091-1117 pair outer cross-core flags per M split. Cube:1054-1057 has zero K loops for zero payload, so its :1278 nUpdate wait is not reached when vector skips the corresponding signal.

Kernel:791-900 preserves two drain iterations and ring ownership independently of bsize. No source precondition bsize>=4 was found in these paths. This does not establish device numerical correctness or latency.
